build.method: Isolated compiler-only reconstruction using the current pinned toolchain and explicit library configuration; historical source/configuration/logs are not inspected. Source maps and legal comments disabled. Not an original release artifact.

methodology: Real advertisement app and UI switch buttons, built library, fresh Chromium profile per trial. Compiler-reconstructed frozen eager API versus current owned API; current page and styles are controlled inputs, not a historical application release. Loopback network/module/font startup included. Owned-store counters observe only advertisement themes (eager results are not bound to that registry), not mount-cycle owners. Blob counters are global to the page. Two frame boundaries and one task precede consistent post-GC sampling. Post-GC CDP heap/backing-storage and sum of browser-process RSS are recorded separately from asset counters. Twenty public mount/disconnect cycles follow app teardown. Telemetry and hooks exist only in this local server.
